description: This PHP source file defines the ProviderAPI class, which implements CRUD operations and related API endpoints for managing OpenID Connect providers within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, and deleting OpenID providers, along with validation rules and transaction handling.

classes.name: ProviderAPI
classes.description: API class for managing OpenID providers with CRUD operations, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting providers, along with validation and transaction management.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all OpenID Providers with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new OpenID Provider, including saving provider details and extra information within a transaction.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves OpenIdProvider entity details from request parameters.

methods.name: saveProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Saves additional provider details into AuthProviderExtraDetails entity, encrypting sensitive data if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs a validation rule for the provider name, enforcing uniqueness and length constraints.

methods.name: getOpenIdProviderCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates an EntityUniquePropertyOption object to specify uniqueness constraints, ignoring certain status values.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove multiple OpenID providers by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete method, mainly for array of IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a single OpenID provider by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single provider by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing OpenID provider's details, including handling transactions and validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update operation, including conditional name uniqueness.
